title: Effect of Zr on the morphology, microstructure and mechanical properties of NbTa0.5TiZrX refractory high entropy alloy fabricated by selective laser melting
process_description: prepared by selective laser melting using DiMetal-150 laser powder bed melting system with 500W fiber laser, 20μm spot diameter, 320W laser power, 500mm/s scanning rate, 30μm layer thickness, 60μm scanning distance, 90° interlayer rotation angle, and preheated titanium substrate at 200°C under Ar atmosphere (<100ppm O2)
